summary: One look recipe (keel-look@1) for every keel/lit stage: the dithered pixel look or the lit full-colour realism look, picked and capped per target, and what a stage sets to draw it. Twin of keel-engine core's resolveLook. Pure.

inputs.label: Look
inputs.help: Where a target can draw both. A small or retro target always draws the pixel look.
